justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/parser/zing/ZingLogParser.java, ZingLine.java, and ZingLineType.java. `rg` found only one production incoming dependency on the package (`core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/parser/ParserFactory.java`) plus the test `core/src/test/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/test/TestZingParser.java`. The package’s outbound imports are mostly shared infrastructure (`AbstractLogParser`, `Tag`, `Task`, `ParseUtil`, `StringUtil`, and model classes), which are also used by other parsers such as `HotSpotLogParser.java` and `J9LogParser.java`, so there is no evidence that this package is a stable package depending on less-stable ones.
